response: Yes, episodic migraineurs do selectively attend to headache-related visual stimuli. Research suggests that individuals who experience episodic migraines tend to have an attentional bias towards stimuli that are related to headaches or migraines, such as words or images associated with pain or discomfort. This selective attention can contribute to increased sensitivity and reactivity to headache-related cues, potentially exacerbating migraine symptoms.
